caustiq.settings.title: Caustiq Shader Settings
caustiq.settings.enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable the selected Caustiq shader pack.
caustiq.settings.compile_budget_tooltip: Maximum number of shader programs compiled per frame while a pack loads. Higher values load packs faster but can cause temporary frame-time spikes.
caustiq.settings.pack_settings_tooltip: Choose an installed shader pack, rescan the shaderpacks folder, and edit pack-defined options.
caustiq.settings.scan_failed: Scan failed. Check the log and try again.
caustiq.settings.no_selection: Select a shader pack above to view its options.
caustiq.settings.selected_pack_tooltip: Choose the shader pack used by CAUSTIQ. Available packs are discovered in the shaderpacks folder.
caustiq.settings.refresh_tooltip: Rescan the shaderpacks folder. Reopen Sodium's settings page after the scan completes to refresh the available choices.
caustiq.settings.shader_option_tooltip: Select a setting from the active shader pack.
caustiq.settings.structural_only: Structural detection only; compatibility is not guaranteed.
